name: Failure-truth and branch-hygiene repository gates
acceptanceCriteria: Executable catch paths are inventoried and classified, and known false-success signatures fail exact-head CI.
Truthful Result-pattern failures, explicit fallback behavior, verified recovery, and telemetry-only cleanup remain distinguishable from user-visible success.
Remote branches are inventoried with canonical, current, merged-awaiting-cleanup, stale, and prohibited-name classifications without automatic deletion.
Repository-truth reports are uploaded as commit-scoped workflow artifacts and historical cleanup remains separately approved.

verification.blocker: Run the exact-head Repository Truth Gate, classify any existing needs-review catch paths, and review the historical branch inventory before raising verification state.
